files.rationale: Kept PR B's per-message MessageItem wiring (messageIds, refreshResponse, selectResponse, isSharedMode) with PR A's getCurrentMessageVersion and version props, and dropped the bottom MessageActions bar because PR B moved those actions into each assistant message (its import was already removed).

Used PR B's props, conditional refresh button and prev/next response navigation, added PR A's optional version-control props so its auto-merged version-switcher block still type-checks, and kept PR A's Message import with PR B's commented-out ShareButton.

Combined PR B's reorganized props (isSharedMode, messageIds, onRefresh, onSelectMessage, no expandedToolResults) and per-message MessageActions with PR A's optional responseVersions/currentVersionIndex/onToggleResponseVersion props and the version indicator calculations.
